name: AutohausAZ
old_description: Though we’ve been selling car parts online since 2000, the Autohaus brand has been around since 1979. We first began selling parts for Euro cars in the late 1970’s. Back then, we specialized in Volvo replacement parts and distributing all Euro parts for Bosch throughout the Arizona valley. Fast forward to present day, and we are selling auto parts online exclusively to millions of do-it-yourselfers worldwide. Just because you find cheap auto parts on our website, we assure each and every one of our customers that we only carry, stock, and ship OEM quality new parts. You’ll never have to worry about getting used European parts from us.
about:
AutohausAZ traces its roots to 1979 when it opened as Autohaus Phoenix in Phoenix, Arizona, supplying European auto parts to local repair shops. The business launched its online store in 2000 and has since grown into a nationwide distributor with multiple warehouses serving hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide.

The company stocks a broad range of OEM and OE-quality replacement parts for European vehicles, covering brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen, Saab, Land Rover, and Mercedes Sprinter. Its catalog includes components from air filters and brake rotors to engine mounts and transmission fluids, all maintained by a team of specialists who verify fitment by year, make, model, and submodel. Orders placed before 2 PM MST ship the same day from the nearest warehouse, and the company backs every part with a three-year, 36-month warranty.

AutohausAZ serves both do-it-yourself enthusiasts and professional repair shops, offering discounted pricing that the company says runs 20 to 90 percent below retail and wholesale levels. Customers include independent mechanics, dealership service departments, and individual owners performing their own maintenance on European makes.

The business was founded to fill a gap in the Phoenix market for reliable European auto parts, and it continues to emphasize direct sourcing, low markups, and a fitment-first catalog as its primary differentiators. A financing option allows buyers to spread the cost of unexpected repairs over time.
